about: Hand-kept from Bandai's official pages (en.onepiece-cardgame.com). The One Piece Market app reads this file; push_alerts.py sends ban-list news to people who own affected cards. Add new entries to the top of 'news' and give each a new id.

news.title: Jewelry Bonney can't share a deck with Luffy (OP13-001) or Law (OP01-002)
news.body: New banned pairs from 27 November 2026: EB05-001 Jewelry Bonney cannot be in the same deck as OP13-001 Monkey.D.Luffy or OP01-002 Trafalgar Law (alt arts included). Bonney herself isn't banned.

news.title: Dracule Mihawk (OP14-020) banned
news.body: OP14-020 Dracule Mihawk can't be used in official tournaments from 12 October 2026.
